meta.name: full-output-enforcement
meta.description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制生成完整代码，禁止占位符截断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到LLM输出被截断或出现占位符的问题
copy.tagline_en: Force complete code generation, ban placeholder truncation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face LLM output truncation or placeholder issues

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把每个任务当成正式交付:你要整份文件就给整份,要 5 个组件就给 5 个。它不用「// ...」「TODO」「其余同理」这类占位写法;输出接近上限时会在干净断点暂停并标出进度。
howto.when: 当任务需要完整、不删减的产出时触发,例如要整份文件、多个组件等。原文写明:适用于任何要求穷尽、无删减输出的任务。

say.text: 把这份文件完整写出来,不要省略任何部分
say.note: 输出完整文件;若暂停按提示回 continue

say.text: 生成 5 个组件,每个都要完整实现
say.note: 逐个交付,不跳过中间部分
从暂停处接着写,不重复不复述

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude treats each task as a full delivery: a full file means the whole file, 5 components means 5. It avoids placeholders like "// ..." or "TODO", and pauses at a clean breakpoint when output nears the token limit.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any task needing complete, unabridged output, such as a full file or multi-part code. The description applies it to any task requiring exhaustive output.

say_en.text: Write the whole file, omit nothing
say_en.note: Full output; on pause, reply continue
All five delivered, no skipped middle
Resumes exactly where it paused, no recap
